summary: Charlotte's Web Holdings filed an 8-K reporting the closing of a subscription agreement with BAT DE Investments Inc., a British American Tobacco subsidiary, under which BAT purchased 14,662,765 common shares at C$0.94 per share for total proceeds of ~C$13.9M (US$10M). The transaction is structured as a direct equity investment, not a tender or a going-private transaction. BAT holds a convertible debenture originally issued in 2022, with a conversion price of C$2.00 per share subject to a 19.9% ownership cap. The deal strengthens BAT's existing stake. What to watch: potential further conversion of the debenture or additional equity investments that could shift control.
